description: List the products of one catalog connected to this channel's WhatsApp Business Account. A product's retailer_id is the product_retailer_id that product messages take. Known limitation: a catalog that is NOT CONNECTED to this WABA, or that does not exist, returns 403 Catalog not accessible - get valid ids from mba_list_product_catalogs. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

catalog_id.description: The catalog ID, as list_product_catalogs returns it.

filter.description: Meta product filter as a JSON string, e.g. {"availability":{"eq":"in stock"}}.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

name: mba_list_catalog_products

data.description: Products of the catalog; which fields are present depends on the fields query parameter

availability.description: Product availability: in stock, out of stock, preorder, available for order, discontinued, pending, mark_as_sold

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the price

id.description: Meta ID of the product item

image_url.description: URL of the main product image

retailer_id.description: Retailer ID (SKU) of the product, as set in the catalog; use it as product_retailer_id in product messages

paging.description: Cursor pagination. next/previous point back at this API; follow them directly, or page manually with the after/before query parameters

next.description: URL of the next page as issued by Meta

previous.description: URL of the previous page as issued by Meta

title: List catalog products
